title: Transport of a duality category with its evaluation and double-dual maps
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal C'$ be locally small symmetric monoidal closed categories [def-nagata-category, def-sfb-monoidal-category], with internal Homs $H,H'$ and natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(B,H(K,M))=\operatorname{Hom}(B\otimes K,M)$ and similarly in $\mathcal C'$. Denote their counits by $\mathrm{ev}$. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C'$ be strong symmetric monoidal, meaning its specified natural tensor and unit isomorphisms satisfy the associativity, unit and symmetry axioms. Fix objects $W\in\mathcal C$, $W'\in\mathcal C'$ and an isomorphism $w:FW\xrightarrow{\sim}W'$. Put $DK=H(K,W)$ and $D'P=H'(P,W')$, as contravariant functors. Define $\delta_K:K\to DDK$ and $\delta'_P:P\to D'D'P$ as the transposes of evaluation with its factors interchanged by the symmetry, as in [lem-weil-duality-pairing].

Let $\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal B'\subseteq\mathcal C'$ be full subcategories closed under isomorphisms. Assume $D$ preserves $\mathcal B$, $F$ restricts to an equivalence $\mathcal B\simeq\mathcal B'$, and for every $K\in\mathcal B$ the canonical comparison $\beta_{K,W}:FH(K,W)\to H'(FK,FW)$, defined by transposing pulled-forward evaluation, is invertible. Put $c_K=H'(1,w)\circ\beta_{K,W}:FDK\xrightarrow{\sim}D'FK$.

Then $D'$ preserves $\mathcal B'$, $c$ is a natural comparison of the restricted contravariant functors, and the following equations hold under the monoidal identifications:
$$\mathrm{ev}'_{FK}\circ(c_K\otimes1)=w\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_K),\qquad
\delta'_{FK}=D'(c_K^{-1})\circ c_{DK}\circ F(\delta_K).$$
If $D:\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal B$ is an anti-equivalence and all $\delta_K$ on $\mathcal B$ are isomorphisms, then $D':(\mathcal B')^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal B'$ is an anti-equivalence and all its specified $\delta'_P$ are isomorphisms. These conclusions use the displayed evaluation-transpose comparisons and specified double-dual maps; no invertibility or duality on the ambient categories is assumed.

proof.text: Use MonoidalClosed.uncurry_injective and uncurry_natural_left/right from Mathlib. The existing ihomComparison_ev supplies evaluation compatibility of the canonical comparison, and map_pre_app_comp_ihomComparison_app supplies naturality in the first variable. proof.text: For each P in B′ choose a preimage K under the restricted equivalence E. Its image FK is isomorphic to P. Compose evaluationDualComparison at K with ihomIsoOfIsoLeft of FK ≅ P. Since DK is in B, FDK is in B′; repleteness puts D′P in B′. NatIso.ofComponents and ObjectProperty.isoMk lift the canonical comparisons, and comparison_natural proves naturality.

proof.text: The displayed evaluation identity follows from comparison_ev by braiding naturality and Functor.LaxBraided.braided. For the bidual identity first prove F(δK) followed by c_DK equals δ′_FK followed by pre(c_K.hom). Uncurry both sides: comparison_ev, tensorator naturality, uncurry_toIhomIhom and preservation of the braiding identify their evaluations. Postcompose with pre(c_K.inv); pre_map and the inverse equation cancel.

source.place: Proof, final paragraph: evaluation comparisons identify their transposes and transport duality along the constructible equivalence

proof.text: If δK is invertible on B, comparison_bidual expresses δ′_FK as a composite of isomorphisms. For arbitrary P in B′ choose FK ≅ P and use toIhomIhom_naturality to express δ′_P as its conjugate by that isomorphism and its double internal-Hom image. Finally ObjectProperty.liftDualEquivalence applied to toIhomIhomNatTrans constructs the target anti-equivalence. The assumed source anti-equivalence is not needed for this stronger elementary inference.

split_report.summary: Proved the formal transport directly from the assumed natural tensor-Hom bijections. Nine explicit elementary steps check evaluation, comparison naturality, closure of the replete subcategory, equality of the two untransposes, naturality of the specified double-dual map, its invertibility, and an explicit contravariant quasi-inverse. No new lemma duplicates a clause of the item; no ambient equivalence, rigidness or biduality is assumed. Statement unchanged.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the final paragraph of lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison: evaluation-defined Hom comparisons identify the transpose double-dual map, and duality transports along the constructible equivalence. The current main-20261015 version retains precisely these clauses in its statement, but has no proof; the original master proof supplies the sentence being expanded. All geometric site-comparison inputs stay with the parent.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q30-b2a4cbcff (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item and recomputed all nine steps by hand; I made no fixes and there are no tool_uses. The delivery has zero new nodes. It is not a re-split order: there is no repair note, the item is not in the dropped list, and it is still unsplit in live and side-live. Statement: the types of beta, c_K and Equation 2 are correct; the chain FK→FDDK→D'FDK→D'D'FK uses c_K^{-1} after the contravariant D', and only c_K needs to be invertible. Steps: (1) U = ev∘(t⊗1) is the inverse bijection by Yoneda; (2) gives Equation 1. (3) The naturality of c reduces to U(H(a,1)) on both sides. (5) and (6) are the two untransposes: (5) uses step 2 at DK, naturality of mu, the transpose identity for delta and the symmetry axiom of F; (6) uses the naturality rule with a=c_K and naturality of tau. They agree, which gives Equation 2. (7) delta' is natural on all of C'. (8) delta' is invertible on B' by conjugation. (9) The quasi-inverse is T^op. Each step is a formal manipulation of a few lines, so elementary=true is justified. Source: the master lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison final paragraph ('Hom comparisons are defined by evaluation … double-dual map'). The live parent's step 6 supplies every hypothesis: beta only at K and D_eK in B, D preserving B, and F=nu^* restricting to an equivalence on D^b_ctf; no ambient equivalence is needed. Edge cases checked: F=id with w=id; a nontrivial w; empty B; W=0. Duplicate search: lem-coef-finite-bidual-transpose (unsplit) is only the scalar-extension special case of steps 5–6 and does not apply to nu^*; it could later cite this item. lem-coef-closed-adjunction-naturality needs an extra adjunction, and lem-trf-closed-evaluation-naturality is a different statement; neither is a duplicate. Advisory: the stmt_dep lem-weil-duality-pairing only fixes the convention for delta and was inherited from Q02.
